name: EMA 20/50 Crossover
about: A classic moving-average crossover trend system: buy when the 20-day EMA crosses above the 50-day EMA while the stock is above its 200-day average; sell the morning after the 20-day EMA closes back below the 50-day EMA. Initial stop 3 x ATR(14) below entry.
source: Moving-average crossover trend following, a standard textbook technique. This version's choices: 20/50 EMAs, a 200-day trend filter, a 3 x ATR protective stop, and the strongest 6-month performers first when slots are short.
style: trend following, swing to positional (weeks to months)
buy_rules: the {fast}-day EMA crosses above the {slow}-day EMA today
sell_rules: sell the morning after the {fast}-day EMA closes below the {slow}-day EMA

risk_suggested.basis: A small risk per trade with up to 10 positions and at most 20% in one stock spreads the risk across many trend trades: most crossover trades end as small losses and a few become large winners. No market filter is suggested because the strategy already requires each stock to be above its own 200-day average. The weekly loss limit and the drawdown halt are set to act only in unusually bad periods for this strategy.
